author: Uday
text:
Human-reviewed gold-uniqueness annotation. origin=human. status=reviewed. Gold is not rewritten.

The reviewer accepted the contested verdict on historical-h2 hd1.

Stem (source definition only): which OAuth 2.0 grant is generally least appropriate for a public SPA with no backend.

Options (letters + short labels; not model response text):
- A: Authorization code + PKCE
- B: Resource owner password credentials (ROPC) — stored/definition gold
- C: Device code
- D: Client credentials for user-delegated browser login — competing explanation

Competing letters: D vs gold B. Baseline stored letters were D; strong-cue stored letters were B (toward gold).

This is one named human review, not two independent blind raters. The package does not overwrite gold. hd1 stays in the primary table. Leave-one-item-out without this item is sensitivity only.
